step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows an architecture for NHS Digital data access. On the left side outside the secure VPC/sandbox, internal users (UserCompanyAnalyst) connect to an EC2 instance acting as a public gateway (Guacamole). From this gateway, authentication flows down to DirectoryService (AD). On the right side of the dotted perimeter (secure sandbox), EMR processes data and connects to S3. S3 connects to KMS for encryption, and KMS connects to RDS. Finally, a second EC2 instance (representing analytics tools in the sandbox) connects up to S3. Exactly 6 directional arrows are present and mapped as edges.
